author: claude
summary: Apple-HIG design review fixes for GlobalQueue history rows and the shared Drawer: eliminated a literal '0' render bug (React truthiness short-circuit), raised remove-button resting opacity + added :focus-visible reveal, disabled the Drawer's resize handle on mobile/touch (full-width sheet) and fixed a keyboard-resize clamp bug that could shrink the drawer below its own 380px minimum on narrow viewports, removed a redundant double title in the compact drawer, de-emphasized 'Pause All' when the queue is empty, replaced hardcoded font-sizes with --type-caption, fixed '1 segments' pluralization, fixed an orphaned bullet separator on wrap, gave cancelled jobs neutral/muted styling distinct from failed (red), and allowed history-row titles to wrap to 2 lines on mobile instead of single-line ellipsis.

files.change: History row: Boolean()-guarded the audio-length/char-count && renders (was rendering literal '0'); added isDone/isCancelled/statusTint/statusColor/StatusIcon (Ban icon, muted color) three-way status styling instead of binary done/error; singular/plural segment count; wrapped bullet+content pairs in a single inline-flex span so they wrap as a unit; replaced 0.65/0.7/0.72rem literals with var(--type-caption); remove button resting opacity 0.4->0.7; header h2 'Global Queue' now only renders when !compact (Drawer already supplies the title); Pause All button disabled/dimmed when chapterJobs.length === 0.
Added .queue-history-remove-btn:focus-visible rule matching the hover-reveal state, and .queue-history-title with a max-width:480px 2-line clamp for mobile.

Added clampDrawerWidth() helper (floors to DRAWER_MIN_WIDTH=380 even when 90vw < 380) and used it for both ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keyboard handlers (was Math.min/Math.max unclamped in one direction). Added isResizeDisabled state (viewport < 768px OR pointer:coarse via matchMedia) that conditionally omits the resize-handle div entirely (no more 12px dead-zone eating backdrop taps) and forces the drawer to width:100% as a full sheet.
New file: removes the drawer's left border on mobile/touch full-width sheet mode.
Updated assertion from '400 chars • 1 segments' to '400 chars • 1 segment' to match the pluralization fix.
